name: TC-368: a multi-item deal is added with one Add; checkout shows 'Part of deal', the deal line, 'You're saving', and the /quote the page makes prices it at the deal price
description: Builder for burger ×2 + fries @ $21: header 'Save 21%' + 'You save $5.50' + 'Available: All days, All day' (validDays = every day), two fixed steps ('2 × <burger>' and the fries), 'All set' from the start; one 'Add deal to cart'. Checkout: 3× 'Part of deal', '1x <deal>' row, 'You're saving $5.50', proceed button is the normal 'Proceed to Payment', and the POST /quote the page issues carries orderDeals and comes back with dealsSubtotal 21 / subtotal 21.
